keywords: Electromagnetic wave shield technology for aircraft
educationalGoal:
New materials such as carbon fiver reinforced plastic and Al-Li alloy are applied for resent aircraft from view points of high functioning and earth-friendly aspects. Students firstly learn some details of materials learned at Materials for Aircraft Structure I and then new materials. Students secondly learn new topics such as lightning-resistant technology and electromagnetic wave shield and stealth technology, and their materials. Student thirdly learn materials for spacecraft.
Students will also learn about possible local job market in aerospace industry.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1. Understand the kinds of new materials and clearly explain the properties in comparison with conventional materials.
2. Explain which new materials are used in which areas of aircrafts with the reason for application of concrete example.
3. Explain lightning-resistant technology,  electromagnetic shield technology and stealth technology with the understanding of their principles and the methods.
4. Explain the necessary properties of materials on the purposes for spacecraft.
achievementLevels.standard:
1. Understand the kinds of new materials and explain the properties.
2. Explain representative example which new materials are used in which areas of aircrafts.
3. Explain the outline of lightning-resistant technology,  electromagnetic shield technology and stealth technology.
4. Explain the representative materials for spacecraft.
